name: Executive Order of July 26, 1876 adding the Camp Wright military reservation to the Round Valley reservation (Royce area 594)
promises: An addition, not a cession: the President added the late Camp Wright military reservation, one mile square in Township 22 North, Range 13 West, to the Round Valley Indian reservation (Royce p. 886).
Royce cross-references the Round Valley orders of March 30, 1870, April 8, 1873 and May 18, 1873 (Royce p. 887).
today: No court, claims-commission or government finding about this one-mile addition was found.

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule pp. 886-887

openQuestions: The later reduction of the Round Valley reservation (Act of October 1, 1890) and the California claims (Indian Claims Commission Dockets 31 and 37) were not researched; whether either touched this mile square was not checked.
The Round Valley Indian Tribes' website (rvit.org) loaded but had no history passage; their account is not recorded.
